human_review.description: Pause the workflow until someone types a reply, then continue with what they wrote. For a yes-or-no decision with named approvers, use Request approval instead.
human_review.name: human_review

parameters.description: What the reviewer sees while the run is paused: the question to answer or the details to check.
parameters.name: content

returns.description: What the reviewer typed before letting the workflow continue.
examples: Approved. The totals match the purchase order.

request_approval.description: Pause the run until someone approves or rejects it. Approvers get an email and an in-app notification with a link, and can leave a comment. The run waits without using any resources, then continues with the decision: add an If step on approved to act on it. Chain several for multi-level approval, or put them in If branches to route by amount.
request_approval.name: request_approval

parameters.description: One line approvers see first, for example: Pay @bill.vendor $@bill.total for invoice @bill.number.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: Everything the approver needs to decide: amounts, line items, and links to the source documents. Links are clickable in the email and the app.
parameters.name: details

parameters.description: Email addresses of the people who can approve, separated by commas. People in this workspace decide in the app; anyone else gets a secure link by email, so a client can approve without an account. Leave empty to let anyone in the workspace who can run workflows approve.
parameters.name: approvers

parameters.description: Only the approvers listed, the listed approvers plus the workspace's owner and admins, or anyone in the workspace who can run workflows (not Viewers).
parameters.name: approver_group

parameters.description: How long to wait for a decision. Leave empty for 72 hours; at most 720 (30 days). Hours can be fractions, for example 0.5 for half an hour.
parameters.name: time_limit_hours

parameters.description: What happens when the time limit runs out.
parameters.name: on_timeout

parameters.description: Remind the approvers this often while the request waits (at most 10 reminders). Leave empty for no reminders. Hours can be fractions, for example 0.5 for half an hour.
parameters.name: remind_every_hours

parameters.description: If nobody has decided after this long, also ask the people in Escalate to. Must be shorter than the time limit. Hours can be fractions, for example 0.5 for half an hour.
parameters.name: escalate_after_hours

parameters.description: Email addresses to escalate to, separated by commas. Leave empty to escalate to the workspace's owner and admins.
parameters.name: escalate_to

parameters.description: The person the run runs as can't approve it: whoever started it, or the workflow's owner for scheduled and triggered runs.
parameters.name: require_different_approver

parameters.description: Email addresses of whoever prepared this item, for example the person who entered the bill. They can't approve it.
parameters.name: prepared_by

parameters.description: A channel ID or #name to post the request to, with a link to decide. Uses this workspace's Slack connection; the Lodol app must be in the channel.
parameters.name: slack_channel

returns.description: The decision: whether it was approved, who decided and when, and any comment they left.

approved.description: True when the request was approved.

comment.description: What the approver wrote, if anything.

timed_out.description: True when nobody decided in time and the time-limit outcome was applied.

description: Pause a workflow until someone approves or rejects it, or until someone replies.
